notes.title: AdventureX 2023 - Steam Event & Demo improvements
notes.content:
We are delighted to announce that Aurora: The Lost Medallion - The Cave has been showcased alongside a selection of extraordinary adventure games at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ASHGAMES/sale/adventurex2023]AdventureX 2023 Steam Event[/url]! Explore this fantastic convention, experience our updated demo, and, if you're captivated by what you see, consider adding Aurora: The Lost Medallion - The Cave to your Steam wishlist.

Thanks to our participation in this remarkable event and your feedback, we've been inspired to make significant changes and additions to our Demo, to enhance your gaming experience. 

Here's a sneak peek at what we've added:
[list]
[*] Greek language support.
[*] Updated Tutorial and Controls Menu with new icons and text.
[*] Viewable inventory objects have magnifying glasses over them.
[*] Flag icons were integrated into the Main Menu.
[*] Added Plus-minus buttons next to the Act synopsis title in the Journal.
[/list]
(Please note that old save games from the previous demo version won't work - Please delete them all.)
